title: Semantic UI Contract and Renderer Family
description:
Replace the ad-hoc UI system and wgpu renderer with a three-layer architecture: (1) a schema-first language-neutral semantic UI contract (UiSnapshot/UiPatch/UiIntent, flat node table, semantic Component enum, LayoutSpec vocabulary, design-token StyleSpec, versioned ActionIds, SurfaceProps, quotas/validation); (2) a headless UI runtime (Entity<T> with mutation leasing, Context effects/subscriptions, actual-read dependency tracking, Present trait, keyed reconciliation producing transactional revisions, CommandGateway/ProjectionInbox seams to the actor kernel, separate coalesced TTL presence channel); (3) renderers consuming that contract — the React DOM renderer and a custom GPU renderer family (transient Element tree, taffy layout, prepaint/paint, coherent double-buffered FrameSnapshot, backend-neutral GpuScene/RenderPacket) over four GraphicsBackend implementations: browser wgpu/WebGPU (wgpu becomes browser-only, enforced), hand-written Direct3D 12 (Windows), Metal (macOS), Vulkan (Linux).

Locked decisions: async at boundaries only — frame construction and input dispatch are synchronous run-to-completion transactions ("await between frames, never halfway through a frame"); big-bang migration with no compatibility layers or V1 freeze (all 33 UiNode-consuming plugins, the manifest TS mirror, the React renderer and the wgpu path migrate in coordinated waves); continuous redraw replaced by invalidation + deadline scheduling (zero idle frames); the renderer stops owning the actor kernel (narrow KernelSeam only — 🎠️runtime.rs is owned by the concurrent MICROKERNEL ticket and must not be edited).

Execution: Opus coordinator (sol) in the main chat, Sonnet executors (terra-*) on file-partitioned packets, Haiku auditors (luna-*) for read-only verification. Seven waves W0-W6 with explicit green gates. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-current-ui-system-silly-giraffe.md; ./compose is out of scope.

Critical verified findings driving the work: the WGSL shader constants in the ui wgpu target were corrupted by a repo-wide asyncify pass (every entry point reads "async fn vs_main"/"async fn fs_main", which naga cannot parse) and several async fns are called without .await, so the committed wgpu-engine render path cannot create pipelines; the WIT already carries a revisioned ui-patch envelope so only the node schema and op addressing change; guest-side diffing is a stub PatchTracker designed to be swapped; plugins reach UI types through a single SDK re-export choke point; and the hand-written TypeScript UiNode mirror exists only because recursion blocked ts-rs, which the flat node table removes.
